verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents Notion's in-app real-time sync, meaning teammates' edits appearing live across open sessions without a refresh. The only 'real-time' evidence is webhook event subscriptions for connections. That is a developer building block for programmatic consumers, not the end-user collaboration capability this story asks about.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing

citations.quote: Connections can subscribe to real-time events — like page updates, property changes, and new comments — via webhooks.
